cards.title: Effective hole-exciton-trion Hamiltonian

source_refs.value: Main Eq. (1) and model paragraph immediately before it

checks.reason: Main Eq. (1) prints all dispersions, the conversion vertex, and the mass relation.
Each quadratic dispersion and detuning has energy units; the two-dimensional vertex has energy times length.
The conversion term preserves total momentum and total hole/exciton constituent numbers.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate three isotropic quadratic dispersions and the on-shell h+x<->t constraint in units of E_F^h and p_F^h.

cards.title: Two-dimensional vacuum scattering amplitude

source_refs.value: Microscopic model section, equations following the Lippmann-Schwinger relation

checks.reason: The supplement prints the f-to-T relation, logarithmic T matrix, pole approximation, and matched vertex.
The continuum branch contributes the required imaginary pi to the logarithm.

For the explicitly negative E_t^0, the caption/first logarithmic expression and the following pole denominator use incompatible detuning signs; no linewidth or Fig. 1(b) parameter set is printed. This caps parameter provenance rather than blocking evaluation of the two printed formulas.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate both labelled sign conventions on a dimensionless energy grid; never infer a pole or width from source pixels.
open_questions: Which sign convention and parameter set generated Main Fig. 1(b)?
What finite linewidth caps its plotted peak?

cards.title: Chemical equilibrium and ideal two-dimensional densities

source_refs.value: Main model paragraphs: fixed injected densities and mu_h+mu_x=mu_t

checks.reason: The main text fixes E_F^h and n_x and imposes chemical equilibrium.
The implemented Fermi/Bose densities follow by analytic integration of quadratic 2D dispersions.
The primary lane inverts the printed free-exciton density and checks mu_t=mu_h+mu_x; a separately labelled conserved-total sensitivity lane is also implemented.

cards.numerical_form: Set mu_h=E_F^h, analytically invert n_x for mu_x, and set mu_t=mu_h+mu_x; optionally solve the conserved-total sensitivity system.
open_questions: The manuscript does not explicitly state whether n_x denotes the free or total exciton-constituent density; the primary lane uses the printed free-species parameterization and retains the alternative as sensitivity.

cards.title: Linearized coupled Boltzmann equations

checks.reason: The supplement prints the three collision equations and their matrix reduction.
Substitution of equilibrium Bose/Fermi functions cancels each forward/reverse reaction factor.
Rotational invariance closes the driven response in the l=1 cosine harmonic, and the quadratic energy delta has two analytic angular roots.
At g=0 the matrix becomes diagonal: holes are Drude and neutral drag is zero.
Direct three-species solution and explicit trion Schur-complement elimination agree to floating-point tolerance; therefore the effective g^4 Q terms of Supplement Eqs. (21)-(32) are retained.

cards.numerical_form: Assemble the l=1 radial collocation matrix using analytic angular delta roots, solve it at each detuning/temperature/frequency, and integrate the currents.
open_questions: The source omits its momentum grid, cutoff, interpolation, and delta regularization; convergence is therefore reconstructed and machine-attested separately.

cards.title: On-shell hole rate and resonance detuning

checks.reason: Main Eqs. (2)-(3) print the rate and resonance condition.
Equal hole and trion Fermi radii with m_t=3m_h gives Delta_star=(2/3)mu_h.
The physical decay rate -2 Im Sigma^R is nonnegative on the allowed phase space.

cards.numerical_form: Use the same analytic angular root/Jacobian as EQ004 and convert the energy rate to ps^-1 with hbar.

cards.title: Species conductivities

checks.reason: The supplement prints the current integral and all normalizations used in the captions.
The normalized hole integral returns one for tau_h=tau_0 and the neutral integrals vanish.
Only the l=1 departure contributes to the longitudinal current; all other angular harmonics integrate to zero.

cards.numerical_form: Apply radial quadrature to the velocity-weighted l=1 solutions and divide by the printed background Drude conductivity.

cards.title: Leading-order Kubo conductivity

checks.reason: The supplement prints the retarded self-energy, finite background widths, and final dc integral.
With interaction self-energy removed, tau_tot=tau_0 and the Drude result is recovered.
The Kubo quadrature does not import or reuse the Boltzmann operator matrix.

cards.numerical_form: Integrate the broadened retarded self-energy over polar momentum and then perform the printed energy integral.
open_questions: The paper's exact energy/momentum cutoffs and quadrature are not printed.

cards.title: Three-fluid ac conductivities

checks.reason: The main text prints the velocity equations and the supplement prints the closed solution and all six fit coefficients.
Direct solution of the 3x3 velocity matrix is compared pointwise with the printed closed form.
The dissipative real part is even and the reactive imaginary part is odd in frequency under the chosen Fourier convention.

cards.numerical_form: Solve the complex 3x3 velocity matrix over the printed -0.8 to 0.8 meV frequency domain and normalize all currents by sigma_0^h.
open_questions: The fitted operating-point species densities are not printed; this case supplies a reconstructed EQ003 closure and does not promote the ac panels to paper-exact.

cards.title: Acoustic-phonon resistivity crossover

source_refs.value: Main Fig. 3 caption and paragraph following its three temperature regimes

cards.latex: rho_{ph}=2pi/(mu_h e^2 tau_{ph}),\quad T_{BG}=2hbar v_s p_F^h approximately 10 K

checks.reason: The paper states the background form, approximately 10 K crossover, and high-temperature linear behavior.
The declared interpolation is strongly suppressed below T_BG and becomes linear above it.
The numerical tau_ph calibration is delegated to external references and is not printed in this paper; the formula remains open only for an explicitly configured proxy.

cards.numerical_form: Use an explicitly configured Bloch-Gruneisen interpolation only as a proxy overlay; it cannot promote T005 or T011 to paper-exact.
open_questions: What material constants and normalization were used for the inset's tau_ph?

cards.title: Far-detuned total-resistivity limit

source_refs.value: Main text below Eq. (3): background Drude resistivity is recovered for sufficiently strong detuning
Main Fig. 3 inset dash-dot lane: Delta much greater than Delta_star

checks.reason: The main text states recovery of the Drude background at strong detuning, and the inset explicitly labels the asymptotic lane.
Removing the off-resonant many-body channel from the total leaves exactly the Drude background plus acoustic-phonon resistivity.
The isolated T011 run checks zero many-body contribution and the component-sum identity to floating-point precision.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the Delta/Delta_star to infinity limit directly. Do not choose or fit a finite far-detuning value from the source figure.
open_questions: The absolute acoustic-phonon calibration remains delegated to external references, so only the limiting structure is paper-exact.
